$comment: OpenAI directory overlay. pack-openai.mjs merges it with brand.json (display name, short description, prompts, URLs). `name` is a placeholder: before uploading, replace it with the plugin ID OpenAI assigns (app-...), or the portal rejects the package. Review test cases and the demo video are added in S5.
name: makemancer

interface.longDescription:
Create images, product photos, video clips, voiceovers, music and sound effects in the conversation. Animate a product photo into a short clip, turn a portrait and a script into a talking video, or compose a jingle for an ad.

Generate and edit images with reference photos that keep a product or face consistent, then build a matching set for a campaign. Generate video from text or images with several video models, and choose native audio or finished speech for speaking shots. Narrate a script with stock voices in many languages, compose songs and instrumentals, and make sound effects. Upscale images and video and remove backgrounds.

Generations use credits from your account; results are saved to your media library. Results vary by model. You can send feedback from the conversation.
capabilities: Generate videos from text or images

publication.release_notes: First release: images, product photoshoots, video clips, voiceovers, music and sound effects.
